THROWBACK: A look back at a moment from the filming of “Back In Blood,” the viral collaboration that brought #LilDurk and #PoohShiesty together for one of the standout records of the early 2020s🎥

Released in 2020, the track quickly became a fan favorite, with its dark production, hard-hitting energy, and unforgettable chemistry between the two Memphis and Chicago rappers. The music video captured that same raw atmosphere, giving fans a behind-the-scenes glimpse into the era when Back In Blood was taking over social media, playlists, and the streets.

The record is now 8x RIAA Certified platinum 💿
